title_en: Notice of the General Office of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction over Maritime Administrative Cases
keywords_en: administrative compensation; Supreme People's Court General Office concerning maritime administrative cases
full_text_en:
General Office of the Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Jurisdiction over Maritime Administrative Cases

Fa Ban [2003] No. 253

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To regulate the jurisdiction over maritime administrative cases, pursuant to the decision made at the 1282nd meeting of the Judicial Committee of this Court, we hereby notify as follows:

1. Administrative cases, administrative compensation cases, and cases concerning the review of applications by administrative organs for the enforcement of their specific administrative acts shall continue to be tried by the administrative divisions of people's courts at all levels. Maritime and other special people's courts shall not hear administrative cases or administrative compensation cases, nor shall they review and enforce cases concerning applications by administrative organs for the enforcement of their specific administrative acts.

2. Maritime administrative cases and administrative compensation cases that have already been accepted by maritime courts prior to the issuance of this Notice shall continue to be heard by the maritime courts; the legal effect of the effective administrative judgments or administrative rulings already made by the maritime courts shall not be affected.

August 11, 2003
